title: AI tools for building zones
author: lostforever2011
selftext:
I want AI to build me zone based on prompt and/or references images which can then be used in unreal engine. I have 3d assets and I tried to get Sol High to build me fairly small zone but it was really bad looking! 

Is there any AI tools which can help build zones pls?

Thanks

replies.author: lostforever2011
replies.body: You mean what us a zone? I mean a small dungeon or small overland zone with mountains in the background,  small village etc.

replies.author: zenmatrix83
replies.body: getting ai to do a detailed 3d scene is not easy, I've been building tools to do it for awhile. look at unreal mcp server if you haven't and that can help, then you can look at blender mcp for some additional things, but actual models you need to download/pay for or you need a local gpu to run something like trellis

replies.author: lostforever2011
replies.body: Ah ok. I have the assets from Fab store but I just want it to put them together but it fails badly. For example, I have water fall asset and mountain assets and I gave it an image in where the water fall is coming from the mountain. It created mountains fine and the water fall was not impressive but the water fall was not attached to the mountain and the water falling into the mountain instead of out from it! The worse part was , the mountain and the waterfall was not blender together to look like one thing...

comments.author: Antonidiuss
comments.body: Unity AI specializes on scene editings

replies.author: lostforever2011
replies.body: What is a "unity ai" pls? When I Google it get results about the unity game engine. Thx

replies.author: Antonidiuss
replies.body: Unity AI inside the Unity game engine.

comments.author: That1guy4226
comments.body: If you're asking what I think you are, a zone is some sorta arena or something similar? If so ask for a blocked out prototype first to just get a rough shape. Then you'll need to tweak and adapt slowly while testing it to get it how you want. I just made a bomberman inspired five room arena mapin unreal. Unfortunately you won't be able to one shot it, probably.

replies.author: lostforever2011
replies.body:
Yes exactly.  I want a small dungeon or small overland zone with mountains in the background,  small village etc. 

Thanks for mentioning "blocked out prototype " , maybe I can try that and get idea before wasting tokens.

replies.author: That1guy4226
replies.body:
Unreal has a level block out tutorial. Id check that out.

It can also procedurally generate a village if you want. Just gotta give it some basic layouts

Landscape + road splines + Level Instance houses + PCG placement + PCG vegetation

Unreal’s official PCG documentation covers the framework, Shape Grammar, biome tools, and PCG Editor Mode.

replies.author: lostforever2011
replies.body: Thanks I will take a look. Maybe I can get the AI to take look and see do a scene or its still not upto it and better to learn and do it by hand? Thx
